verses.text: عَلَى الْمُنْتَقَى خَيْرِ الْبَرَايَا مُحَمَّدِ
verses.transcription: halal muntaqaa khayril baraayaa muhammadi

verses.text: سَلَامَيْكَ خَلِّدْ يَا إِلَهِى بِحُمَّدِ
verses.transcription: salaamayka khallid yaa ilaahii bihummadi

verses.text: أَيَا مَاحِيًا مِّنْ قَبْلِ هَكْسَشٍ مَّآ أَسَآ
verses.transcription: ayaa maahiyan min qabli haksashin maa asaa

verses.text: لِفَضْلٍ وَتَكْرِيمٍ وَمَجْدٍ وَسُودَدِ
verses.transcription: lifadlin wa takriimin wa majdin wa suudadi

verses.text: مَزَايَا كَرَامَتْ عَدَّهَا قَبْلِىَ الْمَلَا
verses.transcription: mazaayaa karaamat haddahaa qabliyal malaa

verses.text: وَكَلُّواْ وَمَا ذُوالِْإِجْتِهَادِ كَذِدَدِ
verses.transcription: wa kalluu wa maa zul ijtihaadi kazidadi

verses.text: هَدَى بِكَ رَبِّى كُلَّ مَنْ رَّامَ هَدْيَهُ
verses.transcription: hadaa bika rabbii kulla man raama had-yahu

verses.text: عَلَيْكَ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ يَاخَيْرَ مُهْتَدِ
verses.transcription: halayka salaatul laahi yaa khayra muhtadi

verses.text: كِتَابُكَ لِى كَنْزٌ وَجَاهٌ وَرِفْعَةٌ
verses.transcription: kitaabuka lii kanzun wa jaahun wa rifhatun

verses.text: وَمَنْ يُّرْضِ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مَوْلَاكَ يَهْتَدِ
verses.transcription: wa man yurdi bil qur-aani mawlaaka yahtadi

verses.text: سَلَامَا الَّذِى أَعْلَاكَ يَاخَيْرَ مُنْزَلٍ
verses.transcription: salaamal lazii  ahlaaka yaa khayra munzalin

verses.text: عَلَى خَيْرِ مَبْعُوثٍ إِلَى الْخَلْقِ مُرْشِدِ
verses.transcription: halaa khayri mabhuusin ilal khalqi murshidi

verses.text: شَكَرْتُ عَلَيْكَ اللَّهِ شُكْرًا يَزِيدُنِى
verses.transcription: shakartu halaykal laahi shukran yaziidunii

verses.text: وَمَنْ بِكَ يَنْحُ الشُّكْرَ يَاذِكْرُ يُرْشَدِ
verses.transcription: wa man bika yanhush shukra yaa zikru  yurshadi

verses.text: فَلَاحُ الَّذِى يَتْلُوكَ يَبْقَى مُخَلَّدً
verses.transcription: falaahul lazii yatluuka yabqaa mukhalladan

verses.text: إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ الْعُلْيَا بِغَيْرِ التَّرَدُّدِ
verses.transcription: ilal jannatil hul-yaa bighayrit taraddudi

verses.text: يَقِينِى يَقِينِى تَرْكَكَ الدَّهْرَ يَا هُدًى
verses.transcription: yaqiinii yaqiinii tarkakad dahra yaa hudan

verses.text: مَحَا بِكَ رَبِّى دُونَ رَدٍّ تَخَدُّدِى
verses.transcription: mahaa bika rabbii duuna raddin takhaddudii

verses.text: رَبَّاحُ الَّذِى يَتْلُوكَ رِنْحُ مُبَشَّرٍ
verses.transcription: rabbaahul lazii yatluuka rinhu mubashsharin

verses.text: وَمَنْ بِكَ يَبْغِ الْفَوْزَ يَاذِكْرُ يَسْعَدِ
verses.transcription: wa man bika yabghil fawza yaa zikru yas-hadi

verses.text: بِكَ اللَّهُ أَعْطَابِى أَمَانًا مِّنَ الْأَذَى
verses.transcription: bikal laahu ahtaanii amaanan minal azaa

verses.text: لَدَى كُلِّ مَنْ يَّدْنُو وَكُلِّ مُبَعَّدِ
verses.transcription: ladaa kulli man yadnuu wa kulli mubahhadi

verses.text: يَقُودُ لِىَ الْبَاقِى بِكَ السُّؤْلَ ءَامِنًا
verses.transcription: yaquudu liyal baaqii bikas su-la aaminan

verses.text: وَمَنْ بِكَ يَبْغِ النَّصْرَ يَاذِكْرُ يُنْجَدِ
verses.transcription: wa man bika yabghin nasra yaa zikru yunjadi

verses.text: عَلِمْتُ يَقِينًا أَنَّكَ الْخَيْرُ وَالْهُدَى
verses.transcription: halimtu yaqiinan annakal khayru wal hudaa

verses.text: وَمَنْ يَّبْغِ مَجْدًا خَالِدَا بِكَ يُمْجَدِ
verses.transcription: wa man yabghi majdan khaalidaa bika yumjadi

verses.text: أَرُومُ بِكَ الْحَاجَاتِ مِنْ خَيْرِمُنْزِلٍ
verses.transcription: aruumu bikal haajaati min khayri munzilin

verses.text: وَلِى بِكَ حَاجٍى قَدْ قَضَى دُورَ مُفْسِدِ
verses.transcription: wa lii bika haajin qad qadaa duura mufsidi

verses.text: لِغَيْرِى انْتَحَتْ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مَضَرَّةٌ
verses.transcription: lighayrin tahat dunyaa wa ukhraa madarratun

verses.text: كَفَانِى بِلَا لُقْيَى بِكَ اللَّهُ حُسَّدِى
verses.transcription: kafaanii bilaa luq-yaa bikal laahu hussadii

verses.text: لِىَ اللَّهُ يُبْدِى الْغَيْبَ مَهْمَى أَرَدْتُّهُ
verses.transcription: liyal laahu yubdil ghayba mahmaa aradtuhu

verses.text: بَكَ الْيَوْمَ يَا قُرْءَانَ رَبِّى وَفِى غَدِ
verses.transcription: bikal yawma yaa qur-aana rabbii wa fii ghadi

verses.text: إِذَا رُمْتُ مِنْ رَّبِّى بِكَ السُّؤْلَ نِلْتُهُ
verses.transcription: izaa rumtu min rabbii bikas su-la niltuhu

verses.text: بِكَ اللَّهُ صَفَّى لِى بَقَآءَ بِأَرْغَدِ
verses.transcription: bikal laahu saffaa lii baqaa-a bi-arghadi

verses.text: وَرِثْتُكَ يَاقُرْءَانَ رَبِّى بِفَضْلِهِ
verses.transcription: wa ristuka yaa qur-aana rabbii bifadlihi

verses.text: فَمَنْ لَّمْ يُوَا فِقْنِى لِغَيْرِىَ يُطْرَدِ
verses.transcription: faman lam yuwaa fiqnii lighayriya yutradi

verses.text: وِدَادِى لِبَاقٍ أَنْزَلَ الذِّكْرَ مُحْكَمًا
verses.transcription: widaadii libaaqin anzalaz zikra muhkaman

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لَمْ يَنْحُنِى ذُو تَمَرُّدِ
verses.transcription: halaa man bihi lam yanhunii zuu tamarrudi

verses.text: لِوَجْهِكَ عَنِّى صَلِّ رَبِّى مُسَلِّمًا
verses.transcription: liwajhika hannii salli rabbii musalliman

verses.text: عَلَى خَيْرِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ طُرًا مُّحَمَّدِ
verses.transcription: halaa khayri khalqil laahi turran muhammadi

bayts.text: عَلَى الْمُنْتَقَى خَيْرِ الْبَرَايَا مُحَمَّدِ ۞ سَلَامَيْكَ خَلِّدْ يَا إِلَهِى بِحُمَّدِ

translations.it.karamati: Sul Prescelto, il Migliore delle creature, Muḥammad, rendi eterno il Tuo saluto, o mio Dio, con (schiere di) lodatori.
translations.en.karamati: Upon the Chosen One, the Best of creatures, Muḥammad, make Your peace everlasting, O my God, with (hosts of) praisers.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur l'Élu, le Meilleur des créatures, Muḥammad, rends éternel Ton salut, ô mon Dieu, avec (des cohortes de) louangeurs.

bayts.text: أَيَا مَاحِيًا مِّنْ قَبْلِ هَكْسَشٍ مَّآ أَسَآ ۞ لِفَضْلٍ وَتَكْرِيمٍ وَمَجْدٍ وَسُودَدِ

translations.it.karamati: O Cancellatore (al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), già da prima dell'anno Hakshash (1325 H / 1907-08), di ciò che era male, per grazia, onore, gloria e signoria.
translations.en.karamati: O Effacer (al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), from before the year Hakshash (1325 AH / 1907-08), of what was evil, through grace, honour, glory and lordship.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Effaceur (al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), dès avant l'année Hakshash (1325 H / 1907-08), de ce qui était mal, par grâce, honneur, gloire et souveraineté.

bayts.text: مَزَايَا كَرَامَتْ عَدَّهَا قَبْلِىَ الْمَلَا ۞ وَكَلُّواْ وَمَا ذُوالِْإِجْتِهَادِ كَذِدَدِ

translations.it.karamati: I (tuoi) privilegi di nobiltà li ha enumerati prima di me l'assemblea (dei sapienti), e si sono stancati: e chi si sforza non è come chi gioca.
translations.en.karamati: Your privileges of nobility the assembly (of the learned) enumerated before me, and they grew weary: and the one who strives is not like one who plays.
translations.fr.karamati: Tes privilèges de noblesse, l'assemblée (des savants) les a énumérés avant moi, et ils se sont lassés : et celui qui s'efforce n'est pas comme celui qui joue.

bayts.text: هَدَى بِكَ رَبِّى كُلَّ مَنْ رَّامَ هَدْيَهُ ۞ عَلَيْكَ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ يَاخَيْرَ مُهْتَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio Signore ha guidato per mezzo tuo chiunque abbia cercato la Sua guida: su di te la benedizione di Allah, o migliore di chi è guidato.
translations.en.karamati: My Lord has guided through you everyone who sought His guidance: upon you be the blessing of Allah, O best of the rightly guided.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon Seigneur a guidé par toi quiconque a recherché Sa guidance : sur toi la bénédiction d'Allah, ô meilleur de ceux qui sont guidés.

bayts.text: كِتَابُكَ لِى كَنْزٌ وَجَاهٌ وَرِفْعَةٌ ۞ وَمَنْ يُّرْضِ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مَوْلَاكَ يَهْتَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il tuo Libro è per me tesoro, rango ed elevazione; e chi compiace con il Corano il tuo Signore è guidato.
translations.en.karamati: Your Book is for me treasure, rank and elevation; and whoever pleases your Lord with the Qurʾān is guided.
translations.fr.karamati: Ton Livre est pour moi trésor, rang et élévation ; et celui qui satisfait par le Coran ton Seigneur est guidé.

bayts.text: سَلَامَا الَّذِى أَعْلَاكَ يَاخَيْرَ مُنْزَلٍ ۞ عَلَى خَيْرِ مَبْعُوثٍ إِلَى الْخَلْقِ مُرْشِدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il saluto di Colui che ti ha innalzato, o migliore (Libro) fatto scendere, sul migliore degli inviati alla creazione, guida retta.
translations.en.karamati: The peace of Him Who raised you, O best (Book) sent down, upon the best envoy to creation, the rightly guiding.
translations.fr.karamati: Le salut de Celui qui t'a élevé, ô meilleur (Livre) descendu, sur le meilleur des envoyés à la création, guide droit.

bayts.text: شَكَرْتُ عَلَيْكَ اللَّهِ شُكْرًا يَزِيدُنِى ۞ وَمَنْ بِكَ يَنْحُ الشُّكْرَ يَاذِكْرُ يُرْشَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Ho ringraziato Allah per te di una gratitudine che mi accresce; e chi per mezzo tuo si dirige alla gratitudine, o Ricordo (il Corano), è ben guidato.
translations.en.karamati: I have thanked Allah for you with a gratitude that increases me; and whoever through you turns to gratitude, O Remembrance (the Qurʾān), is rightly guided.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai remercié Allah pour toi d'une gratitude qui m'accroît ; et celui qui par toi se dirige vers la gratitude, ô Rappel (le Coran), est bien guidé.

bayts.text: فَلَاحُ الَّذِى يَتْلُوكَ يَبْقَى مُخَلَّدً ۞ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ الْعُلْيَا بِغَيْرِ التَّرَدُّدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il successo di chi ti recita rimane eterno, fino al Giardino eccelso, senza esitazione.
translations.en.karamati: The success of whoever recites you remains everlasting, up to the lofty Garden, without hesitation.
translations.fr.karamati: Le succès de celui qui te récite demeure éternel, jusqu'au Jardin sublime, sans hésitation.

bayts.text: يَقِينِى يَقِينِى تَرْكَكَ الدَّهْرَ يَا هُدًى ۞ مَحَا بِكَ رَبِّى دُونَ رَدٍّ تَخَدُّدِى

translations.it.karamati: La mia certezza mi preserva dall'abbandonarti, per sempre, o Guida; per mezzo tuo il mio Signore ha cancellato, senza ritorno, il mio deperimento.
translations.en.karamati: My certainty guards me from forsaking you, forever, O Guidance; through you my Lord has effaced, without return, my wasting away.
translations.fr.karamati: Ma certitude me préserve de t'abandonner, pour toujours, ô Guidance ; par toi mon Seigneur a effacé, sans retour, mon dépérissement.

bayts.text: رَبَّاحُ الَّذِى يَتْلُوكَ رِنْحُ مُبَشَّرٍ ۞ وَمَنْ بِكَ يَبْغِ الْفَوْزَ يَاذِكْرُ يَسْعَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il guadagno di chi ti recita è il guadagno di chi ha ricevuto la buona novella; e chi per mezzo tuo cerca il successo, o Ricordo, è felice.
translations.en.karamati: The gain of whoever recites you is the gain of one given glad tidings; and whoever through you seeks success, O Remembrance, is made happy.
translations.fr.karamati: Le gain de celui qui te récite est le gain de qui a reçu la bonne nouvelle ; et celui qui par toi cherche le succès, ô Rappel, est heureux.

bayts.text: بِكَ اللَّهُ أَعْطَابِى أَمَانًا مِّنَ الْأَذَى ۞ لَدَى كُلِّ مَنْ يَّدْنُو وَكُلِّ مُبَعَّدِ

translations.it.karamati: Per mezzo tuo Allah mi ha dato sicurezza dal danno, presso chiunque si avvicini e chiunque sia lontano.
translations.en.karamati: Through you Allah has given me safety from harm, among everyone who draws near and everyone far off.
translations.fr.karamati: Par toi Allah m'a donné la sécurité contre le mal, auprès de quiconque s'approche et de quiconque est éloigné.

bayts.text: يَقُودُ لِىَ الْبَاقِى بِكَ السُّؤْلَ ءَامِنًا ۞ وَمَنْ بِكَ يَبْغِ النَّصْرَ يَاذِكْرُ يُنْجَدِ

translations.it.karamati: L'Eterno mi conduce per mezzo tuo la richiesta, (me) al sicuro; e chi per mezzo tuo cerca la vittoria, o Ricordo, è soccorso.
translations.en.karamati: The Everlasting leads to me through you my request, (I) in safety; and whoever through you seeks victory, O Remembrance, is succoured.
translations.fr.karamati: L'Éternel me conduit par toi la requête, (moi) en sécurité ; et celui qui par toi cherche la victoire, ô Rappel, est secouru.

bayts.text: عَلِمْتُ يَقِينًا أَنَّكَ الْخَيْرُ وَالْهُدَى ۞ وَمَنْ يَّبْغِ مَجْدًا خَالِدَا بِكَ يُمْجَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Ho saputo con certezza che tu sei il bene e la guida; e chi cerca una gloria eterna, per mezzo tuo è glorificato.
translations.en.karamati: I have known with certainty that you are the good and the guidance; and whoever seeks everlasting glory is glorified through you.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai su avec certitude que tu es le bien et la guidance ; et celui qui cherche une gloire éternelle, par toi est glorifié.

bayts.text: أَرُومُ بِكَ الْحَاجَاتِ مِنْ خَيْرِمُنْزِلٍ ۞ وَلِى بِكَ حَاجٍى قَدْ قَضَى دُورَ مُفْسِدِ

translations.it.karamati: Cerco per mezzo tuo i bisogni dal migliore di coloro che fanno scendere (la Rivelazione), e per me, per mezzo tuo, (Egli) ha già soddisfatto il mio bisogno, senza (alcun) corruttore.
translations.en.karamati: Through you I seek my needs from the best Sender-down (of Revelation), and for me, through you, (He) has already fulfilled my need, without (any) corrupter.
translations.fr.karamati: Je recherche par toi les besoins auprès du meilleur de ceux qui font descendre (la Révélation), et pour moi, par toi, (Il) a déjà satisfait mon besoin, sans (aucun) corrupteur.

bayts.text: لِغَيْرِى انْتَحَتْ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مَضَرَّةٌ ۞ كَفَانِى بِلَا لُقْيَى بِكَ اللَّهُ حُسَّدِى

translations.it.karamati: Verso altri che me si è diretto il danno, in questo mondo e nell'altro; Allah, per mezzo tuo, mi ha preservato senza scontro dai miei invidiosi.
translations.en.karamati: Toward others than me harm has turned, in this world and the next; Allah, through you, has spared me my enviers without encounter.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers d'autres que moi s'est dirigé le mal, en ce monde et dans l'autre ; Allah, par toi, m'a préservé sans affrontement de mes envieux.

bayts.text: لِىَ اللَّهُ يُبْدِى الْغَيْبَ مَهْمَى أَرَدْتُّهُ ۞ بَكَ الْيَوْمَ يَا قُرْءَانَ رَبِّى وَفِى غَدِ

translations.it.karamati: A me Allah manifesta l'invisibile ogniqualvolta lo voglio, per mezzo tuo, oggi, o Corano del mio Signore, e domani.
translations.en.karamati: To me Allah reveals the unseen whenever I wish it, through you, today, O Qurʾān of my Lord, and tomorrow.
translations.fr.karamati: À moi Allah dévoile l'invisible chaque fois que je le veux, par toi, aujourd'hui, ô Coran de mon Seigneur, et demain.

bayts.text: إِذَا رُمْتُ مِنْ رَّبِّى بِكَ السُّؤْلَ نِلْتُهُ ۞ بِكَ اللَّهُ صَفَّى لِى بَقَآءَ بِأَرْغَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Quando cerco dal mio Signore, per mezzo tuo, la richiesta, la ottengo; per mezzo tuo Allah mi ha reso pura la permanenza con la più grande agiatezza.
translations.en.karamati: When I seek my request from my Lord through you, I obtain it; through you Allah has made my abiding pure for me with the greatest ease.
translations.fr.karamati: Quand je recherche de mon Seigneur, par toi, la requête, je l'obtiens ; par toi Allah m'a rendu pure la permanence avec la plus grande aisance.

bayts.text: وَرِثْتُكَ يَاقُرْءَانَ رَبِّى بِفَضْلِهِ ۞ فَمَنْ لَّمْ يُوَا فِقْنِى لِغَيْرِىَ يُطْرَدِ

translations.it.karamati: Ti ho ereditato, o Corano del mio Signore, per Sua grazia (Corano 35:32): chi non è d'accordo con me sia scacciato verso altri che me.
translations.en.karamati: I have inherited you, O Qurʾān of my Lord, by His grace (Qurʾān 35:32): whoever does not agree with me is driven off toward others than me.
translations.fr.karamati: Je t'ai hérité, ô Coran de mon Seigneur, par Sa grâce (Coran 35:32) : quiconque n'est pas d'accord avec moi est chassé vers d'autres que moi.

bayts.text: وِدَادِى لِبَاقٍ أَنْزَلَ الذِّكْرَ مُحْكَمًا ۞ عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ لَمْ يَنْحُنِى ذُو تَمَرُّدِ

translations.it.karamati: Il mio amore (va) a un Eterno che ha fatto scendere il Ricordo, saldo, su colui per mezzo del quale non si è diretto verso di me alcun ribelle.
translations.en.karamati: My love (goes) to an Everlasting One Who sent down the Remembrance, firmly set, upon him through whom no rebel has come near me.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon amour (va) à un Éternel qui a fait descendre le Rappel, affermi, sur celui par qui ne s'est dirigé vers moi aucun rebelle.

bayts.text: لِوَجْهِكَ عَنِّى صَلِّ رَبِّى مُسَلِّمًا ۞ عَلَى خَيْرِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ طُرًا مُّحَمَّدِ

translations.it.karamati: Per il Tuo Volto, da parte mia, benedici, mio Signore, salutando, il Migliore della creazione di Allah tutta, Muḥammad.
translations.en.karamati: By Your Face, on my behalf, bless, my Lord, with peace, the Best of all Allah's creation, Muḥammad.
translations.fr.karamati: Par Ta Face, de ma part, bénis, mon Seigneur, en saluant, le Meilleur de toute la création d'Allah, Muḥammad.
